title: Hardcoded SF=12 instead of using computed sf variable
description:
File: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:225

When utilization > 200, returns hardcoded SFResult(12, False) instead of SFResult(sf, False), violating the pseudocode in the docstring which specifies returning the SF variable after the MIN operation.

**Failure scenario:** adaptive_sf_select(assigned_sf=7, density=0, ema_snr=0, utilization=201) returns SFResult(12, False) but should return SFResult(10, False) per the documented pseudocode.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
close_reason: Resolved against oracle: hardcoded SF=12 on utilization>200 is REQUIRED by test/vectors/ccp16_utilization.json utilization_high_with_sf7_baseline (assigned_sf=7 -> sf=12) and spec/02-physical-link.md sec 3.5 select_tx_sf ('return 12, false'). Changing to computed SF would regress the vector oracle. Actual defect was the stale docstring citing spec/02a sec 2a.7 pseudocode; docstring corrected to match normative spec/02 behavior. Behavior unchanged, tests pass.
